rounds.q: Venus is farther from the Sun. Higher or lower?
rounds.fact: Its thick carbon dioxide air traps heat like a greenhouse.

rounds.q: How long does one spin take? Higher or lower?
rounds.fact: Venus spins slower than it travels around the Sun.

voice.hook: Venus breaks the rules. Two questions. Beat the clock!
voice.q0: Mercury's days can hit 800 degrees Fahrenheit. Venus is farther from the Sun. Higher, or lower?
voice.r0: Higher! Venus averages about 847 degrees. Its thick atmosphere traps the heat.
voice.q1: Venus takes 225 Earth days to circle the Sun. How long to spin once? Higher, or lower?
voice.r1: Higher! 243 Earth days. Venus spins slower than it orbits.
voice.outro: How many did you get? Follow Liftoff for more!

facts: Mercury: daytime temperatures can reach about 800°F (NASA Space Place, Weather on Other Planets)
Venus: average temperature about 847°F; its thick carbon dioxide atmosphere traps heat (NASA Space Place)
Venus: one orbit of the Sun takes 225 Earth days; one spin on its axis takes 243 Earth days (NASA Space Place, All About Venus)
